title: H1: evening Coconala re-scan (ids > last screened); send under PG-1 (first-win, ≤5/day)
detail: FIRST-WIN rule (STATE H1.selection_rule): pick the SMALLEST, fastest, objective-done jobs at ¥5,000-10,000 PG-profitable, lead with a free sample + an explicit done-definition, ≤5/day combined with CrowdWorks. Scan https://coconala.com/requests?recruiting=true&sort=new (pages 1-3, in-page fetch + DOMParser, remove style/script) for ids > the last screened (5329355 as of 10/16 19:06; the 10:00 h1-coconala-scan-1017 will advance it). Send under PG-1 when conditions 1-7 hold and log each (event proposal_sent --grant PG-1 + signal proposal_sent). Respect the 10/18 checkpoint decision. On done: create the next evening scan.
